title: iPhone 4 - Technical Specifications
summary: Apple's official technical specification page lists iPhone 4 display, camera, cellular/wireless, battery, sensors, size, and software support details used to seed the product-level decomposition.
limitations: Official product specs do not expose full BOM, supplier choices, process parameters, or cost structure.

title: iPhone 4 Product Environmental Report
summary: Apple's environmental report provides product material and environmental context useful for modeling the glass, steel, battery, electronics, packaging, and recycling branches at a high level.
limitations: Environmental report is not a detailed manufacturing traveler, supplier list, or complete materials audit.

title: WEGOVY (semaglutide) injection label
summary: FDA label evidence for semaglutide drug identity, indication, dosage form, warnings, contraindications, adverse reactions, and regulated use context.
limitations: Regulatory label supports approved-use and safety claims but not raw-material capacity, manufacturing cost, payer access, or comparative effectiveness across the product family.

title: Once-Weekly Semaglutide in Adults with Overweight or Obesity
sourceName: New England Journal of Medicine / PubMed
summary: STEP 1 randomized trial record for once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg in adults with overweight or obesity, supporting clinical efficacy evidence and weight-change metric modeling.
limitations: Trial evidence does not by itself establish manufacturing capacity, affordability, real-world adherence, long-term discontinuation outcomes, or all GLP-1 product variants.

title: Falcon 9
summary: SpaceX official Falcon 9 page describes the vehicle as reusable and supports modeling first-stage reuse as a mature branch of reusable orbital launch capability.
limitations: Vendor source does not disclose full cost, refurbishment labor, marginal cost, or upper-stage reuse requirements for the 1,000 USD/kg target.

title: The Reusable Launch Vehicle Technology Program
summary: NASA technical-report record documents reusable launch vehicle technology development as a recurring route to improved access to space, supporting the cost-target framing and technology-route decomposition.
limitations: Historical program source is not a current commercial launch-cost benchmark and does not validate the specific 1,000 USD/kg target.

title: ITER Superconducting Magnets
summary: ITER official machine-system page describes superconducting magnets, cryogenic feeds, power supplies, and magnet-system functions relevant to tokamak fusion decomposition.
limitations: ITER is an experimental facility, not a commercial power plant; this source does not prove plant economics or tritium self-sufficiency.

title: Nuclear fusion power, fusion energy research, ITER
summary: IAEA overview supports high-level modeling of controlled fusion research, plasma physics, international development, and remaining power-plant maturity gaps.
limitations: Overview source is broad; it does not validate a specific commercial plant architecture, cost target, availability factor, or material lifetime.

title: Microreactors
summary: NRC microreactor page supports the regulated deployment context for microreactors and the need to model licensing readiness, advanced-reactor review paths, safety, and deployment constraints.
limitations: Regulatory overview does not validate a specific design, fuel qualification status, cost, or site approval.

title: Small modular reactors
summary: IAEA SMR overview supports modeling small modular and microreactor deployment as a family of modular, factory-fabricated, regulated nuclear products.
limitations: Broad overview; does not resolve design-specific fuel, security, cost, waste, or licensing evidence gaps.

title: AK-47
summary: Britannica provides historical context for the AK-47 product family, designer, adoption, and widespread use. It is used here only for high-level industrial-history modeling.
limitations: General historical source; not suitable for detailed manufacturing, operation, or performance optimization claims.

title: AK-47 history and impact materials
summary: Museum historical material source placeholder for reviewing the AK-47 as a high-level industrial and historical case, especially diffusion, standardization, and social impact.
limitations: Placeholder source pointer; needs a specific reviewed museum article or collection record before promoting detailed claims.
